gallery.title: Art Gallery
gallery.description: Explore a curated collection of SummerFloofy’s illustrations featuring character art, VTuber fanart, and artwork of her original character, Floofy. With expressive posing, soft rendering, and carefully balanced color palettes, each piece reflects her distinct artistic style and attention to detail.

discover.title: Discover SummerFloofy
discover.description: Learn more about SummerFloofy, explore commission opportunities, and join live streams with the Floofy and the Tangerines!

about.title: About
about.description: SummerFloofy is a digital illustrator and streamer known for her soft, elegant character artwork. Her work includes VTuber fanart, character art, and illustrations of her original character, Floofy. She is supported by her community of fans, known as the Tangerines, who play a big part in shaping the positive and creative space around her work.

commission.title: Commissions
commission.description: Bring your ideas to life with custom artwork created in SummerFloofy’s delicate signature style. Whether you’re looking for character art, VTuber-inspired illustrations, or personalized artwork, each commission is crafted with care and attention to detail.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Join SummerFloofy live for drawing sessions, creative chats, and community interaction with the Tangerines. Streams offer a behind-the-scenes look at the artistic process, often with lots of nonsense and fun sprinkled in.

support.title: Support SummerFloofy’s journey
support.description: Whether you’re sharing artwork, leaving a review, donating, or stopping by a stream, every bit of support helps SummerFloofy continue creating and growing.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: See what clients and members of the Tangerine community have shared about their experiences with SummerFloofy’s artwork and commissions. You can leave your own feedback and share your experience with other visitors!

donate.title: Donate
donate.description: Support SummerFloofy’s art, streams, and future projects. Every contribution helps fund new creative work, improve content, and keep the community thriving.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Use this page for collaborations, business questions, press, fan mail, and other messages that are not commissions.

artist.name: Summer Floofy
artist.short_desc: SummerFloofy is an illustrator and streamer known for creating soft, delicate character artwork filled with warmth and charm. From VTuber fanart to illustrations featuring her original character, Floofy, each piece is thoughtfully crafted with graceful details, gentle colors, and a distinctly feminine touch.
artist.extended_desc: Beyond her illustrations, SummerFloofy shares her world through art and gaming streams, where creativity, kindness, and community take center stage. Together with her fans, the Tangerines, she has built a warm and welcoming corner of the internet filled with laughter, encouragement, and the occasional courtroom drama. Whether she's drawing elegant characters, joined by her sibling Poofy, or sentencing mischievous Tangerines to the blender for their latest offenses, she brings a thoughtful and lighthearted spirit to everything she does. As she continues to grow as an artist, her goal remains simple: to create beautiful artwork and memorable experiences that brighten someone's day.

terms.title: Commission Terms
terms.description: Policies, workflow, and terms for all commission requests.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.item_2: Additional characters, props, backgrounds, and complex character designs may incur additional fees.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.item_1: 1 major revision during the sketch phase.
revisions.item_2: 2 minor revisions during the coloring phase.
revisions.item_3: Additional revisions may incur extra charges.
revisions.item_4: Major revisions include significant changes such as pose or expression adjustments.

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: If you have questions or would like updates on your commission, feel free to contact me by email or through the contact page on this website. I'll do my best to respond as soon as possible.

artwork_usage.title: Artwork Usage
artwork_usage.unsure: Not sure? Tell me how you plan to use the artwork, and I'll recommend the appropriate license.

payment.title: Payment
payment.item_1: Full payment is required before work begins.
payment.item_2: After your request has been reviewed and discussed, you'll be able to complete payment through Stripe or Ko-fi.

tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.usage_item_1: Your commission may only be used according to the usage license selected at the time of purchase.
tos.usage_item_2: If you're unsure whether a particular use is covered, please contact me before using the artwork.
tos.ownership_licensing_item_1: I retain the copyright to all commissioned artwork unless otherwise agreed in writing.
tos.ownership_licensing_item_2: Purchasing a commission grants you a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the artwork according to the selected usage license. Copyright ownership is not transferred.
tos.ownership_licensing_item_3: Any use beyond the selected license requires prior written permission and may require an additional licensing fee.
tos.portfolio_item_1: I may display commissioned artwork in my portfolio, gallery, or on social media.
tos.portfolio_item_2: If you'd like your commission to remain private, please let me know before work begins.
tos.modifications_item_1: Editing, painting over, or AI-generated modifications of the artwork are not permitted without permission.
tos.ai_blockchain_item_1: My artwork may not be used for AI training, machine learning datasets, or similar technologies.
tos.ai_blockchain_item_2: My artwork may not be used for NFTs, cryptocurrency, or other blockchain-related technologies.
tos.delivery_item_1: Final artwork will be delivered in its original resolution via email or another agreed-upon method.
tos.refunds_item_1: Payments are non-refundable once work has begun.
tos.conduct_item_1: I reserve the right to decline any commission request.
tos.conduct_item_2: Harassment, abusive behavior, spam, or repeated violations of these terms may result in rejection of future commissions or placement on my blacklist.
